sourceChecks.title: Diphyllin Shows a Broad-Spectrum Antiviral Activity against Multiple Medically Important Enveloped RNA and DNA Viruses
sourceChecks.excerpt: blocks the replication of multiple phylogenetically unrelated enveloped RNA and DNA viruses

sourceChecks.title: Selective decline of intact HIV reservoirs during the first decade of ART followed by stabilization in memory T cell subsets
sourceChecks.excerpt: followed for 20 years while continuing ART
sourceChecks.paraphrase: In nine people with HIV followed during ART, intact proviral reservoir declined early, then stabilized in memory T-cell subsets over the second decade.
sourceChecks.limitations: Observational cohort of nine people on ART; it does not establish a full latency circuit, reversible switch, or reservoir eradication.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: HIV reservoir latency reversal eradication long term primary study

sourceChecks.title: Predicting the potential for zoonotic transmission and host associations for novel viruses
sourceChecks.excerpt: Trained models were used to predict possible host links for 531 novel viruses
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The study trained and validated network models on observed virus-host links and generated risk/host predictions for 531 of 944 novel animal viruses.
sourceChecks.limitations: Predicted associations are not causal mechanisms or reliable pandemic forecasts; 413 viruses lacked predictions and the authors call for further characterization.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: viral host jump prediction model validation zoonotic emergence genomic primary study

sourceChecks.title: Attenuation of RNA viruses by redirecting their evolution in sequence space
sourceChecks.excerpt: viruses generated more Stop mutations both in vitro and in vivo
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The study engineered Coxsackie B3 and influenza A genomes to direct evolution toward stop mutations, reporting reduced fitness and attenuation in vivo with protection against challenge.
sourceChecks.limitations: Specific engineered RNA-virus examples do not establish universal reproducible directed evolution across viruses or safe attenuation across all pathogen classes.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: directed evolution viral attenuation high efficiency reproducible virus passage primary study vaccine
